The world of Eyum is a TTRPG I made. It doesn't have classes and instead uses skill trees. It is in very early access. 

The wiki is available here https://thoroftroy.github.io/Eyum-TTRPG/



###### Ai Disclamer
I used Opencode with Deepseak v4 on this project to test and find inconcicentices. Ai was never used in any way to generate any actual content, only to check content and find inconcinecnies, typos, and other similar issues. Think of it like an edditor which I had to use beacuse I am broke and have no friends.
